name: Covert Cups | 200mg Rosin Chocolate Treats | Dubai
description:
Take a bite out of the ordinary with our HASH ROSIN DUBAI CUPS!

Delicious and discrete, our HASH ROSIN Dubai Cups are a luxurious way to get high on the low. Each package comes with 8 MINI Cups totaling 200mg THC.

Packing 25mg THC into each cup, this indulgent treat is the perfect pick-me-up, specially crafted to microdose your experience.

Our Dubai Cups feature a silky gourmet milk chocolate shell filled with rich pistachio cream and delicate shredded kunafah, inspired by the decadent flavors of the Middle East. Every bite delivers a smooth, nutty sweetness with a satisfying crunch that melts in your mouth and hits just right.

Covert Cups hash rosin chocolate edible cups are cannabis-infused chocolates celebrated for their high potency, exotic flavor profiles, and unforgettable taste.
